translations.web: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.
translations.bsb: For the wealthy of the city are full of violence, and its residents speak lies; their tongues are deceitful in their mouths.
translations.kjv: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
